desc: Canonical motion registry with Standard Descriptive Characteristics (SDC). Every normative field cites RONR 12th ed. as section:paragraph strings. Applicability (SDC-2) and yield relations live in precedence.json (table/applicability, table/appeal-yield-matrix).

schema.id: kebab-case of RONR's canonical motion name; unique across the model
schema.name: RONR display name
schema.class: M | S | P | I | B | M/B (Table II key)
schema.rank: 1-13 for the ranked chain (1 = main, lowest); null for unranked
schema.vote: list of sufficient alternative thresholds (vocabulary.json thresholds)
schema.reconsider: yes | no | neg-only | aff-only | conditional object

yes-restricted.desc: debate confined to the motion's own merits, not the underlying question

yes-opens-question.desc: debate may go fully into the merits of the question acted on

if-target-debatable.desc: inherits debatability from the motion it is applied to

ranked_chain.desc: The thirteen ranked motions form a total order: each takes precedence over all lower ranks and yields to all higher [5:11]. Listed ascending.

motions.name: Main motion
motions.vote_exceptions: bylaw/special-rule thresholds; suspends-a-rule -> two-thirds; changes-something-adopted -> rescind thresholds [10:8(7)]

motions.name: Postpone Indefinitely
motions.notes: kills the main question for the session on adoption [11:3]; dropped if main question is committed [11:4, 13:19]

motions.name: Amend
motions.vote_notes: majority regardless of target's own threshold [12:7(7)]
motions.notes: must be germane [12:6, 12:16-21]; rank rises when applied to a variable in a higher-ranked motion (precedence.json rank_modifications)

motions.name: Commit / Refer

reconsider.aff: only until committee takes up the question [13:7(8)]
reconsider.neg: until progress makes it a new question, then renewable [13:7(8), 38:7(1)]

motions.notes: variants: committee-of-the-whole, quasi-committee, informal consideration [13:2]; admissibility conditions in precedence.json table/applicability

motions.name: Postpone to a Certain Time
motions.vote_exceptions: two-thirds if it makes the question a special order; an amendment adding that provision still needs only majority [14:4(7)]
motions.notes: limit: not beyond next regular session within a quarterly interval; never such that it kills the question (that reading converts to postpone-indefinitely) [14:6, 14:9] (guard/postpone-horizon); admissibility conditions in precedence.json table/applicability

motions.name: Limit or Extend Limits of Debate

reconsider.aff: unexecuted part only, any time before exhaustion [15:5(8)]

motions.notes: superseding conflicting orders allowed while pending questions remain [15:17]; exhaustion at 15:18 (rules.json orders; lifecycle.json timers)

motions.name: Previous Question

reconsider.aff: only before any vote taken under the order [16:5(8)]; structurally never after the covered bundle returns from a postponement — the postponing vote itself partly executed the order [16:15]; if reconsideration of the adopted order prevails, the PQ is presumed rejected without a revote [16:16] (lifecycle transition exception)

motions.notes: qualified form covers a consecutive series from the immediately pending question [16:5(2)]; competing wider/narrower PQ motions voted widest-first (quasi-filling-blanks) [16:5(6)]; nonstandard wordings ('call the question') are this motion [16:6]

motions.name: Lay on the Table
motions.notes: cannot be qualified [17:21]; carries the whole adhering bundle [17:5]; misuse-to-kill is out of order [17:2, 17:13-16]

motions.name: Call for the Orders of the Day
motions.vote_notes: orders enforced on one member's demand; set aside only by two-thirds (as neg vote on proceeding, or aff vote to suspend/extend) [18:4(7), 18:8]
motions.notes: interrupts a pending question only when a special order is being neglected [18:4(1), 18:5]; except when a special order must be taken up, also yields to a reconsider being made or called up [18:4(1)]; not in committee of the whole [18:6]

motions.name: Raise a Question of Privilege

interrupt.when: urgency justifies; not during voting/verification; not a speaker already speaking unless purpose would otherwise be defeated

motions.second_notes: the motion raised, if any, needs a second [19:6(4)]
motions.vote_notes: chair rules on admission; the admitted question is then an ordinary main motion [19:3, 19:6(7)]

motions.name: Recess (privileged: moved while business pending)
motions.variant: recess-main when no question pending or for a future time [20:3] — class M, debatable, amendable

motions.name: Adjourn (privileged: unqualified, another meeting provided for, no adjournment hour set)
motions.not_in_order: during voting or vote verification, before result announced (ballot-collection exception) [21:6(1)]
motions.variant: adjourn-main when qualified, an adjournment hour already set, or adoption would dissolve the assembly [21:3] — class M, debatable, amendable, not privileged; retains privileged rules when unqualified even with no question pending [21:2]

motions.name: Fix the Time to Which to Adjourn (privileged: moved while question pending)
motions.not_in_order: if a later meeting of the same session is already scheduled [22:2]; movable even after vote to adjourn, before declaration [22:6(1)]
motions.variant: fix-time-main when no question pending [22:4] — class M, debatable

incidental.desc: Unranked; admission by guard/legitimately-incidental and per-motion conditions (precedence.json incidental_admission).

motions.name: Point of Order
motions.debatable: no (if chair submits to assembly: debatability follows appeal rules [23:2(5), 23:19])
motions.reconsider: no (assembly's vote on a submitted point: yes [23:2(8)])
motions.timeliness: at the time of the breach [23:5]; continuing-breach exceptions [23:6]

motions.name: Appeal

interrupt.when: at the time of the ruling appealed

motions.debatable: yes, except: indecorum/rules-of-speaking, priority of business, or undebatable question immediately pending/involved -> no [24:3(5)]; one speech per member, chair may speak twice [24:3(5)]
motions.vote_notes: majority in the negative required to reverse [24:3(7)]

motions.name: Suspend the Rules
motions.vote_exceptions: ordinary standing rules -> majority [25:15]; never against a negative vote as large as the minority the rule protects [25:2(7)]
motions.renewal: not same purpose same meeting except unanimous consent; renewable after adjournment [25:6]
motions.unsuspendable: bylaws (except rules-of-order-in-nature or self-suspending), law, fundamental principles, absentee protections, basic individual rights, rules applying outside the session [25:7-13] (rules.json unsuspendable)

motions.name: Objection to the Consideration of a Question

interrupt.when: until debate begins or any subsidiary motion except lay-on-table is stated

motions.vote_notes: two thirds voting against consideration sustains; question put as 'shall the question be considered' [26:7-8]

motions.name: Division of a Question
motions.notes: parts must each stand alone and jointly equal the whole [27:5-6]; independent-subject series and non-conforming amendment series split on single-member demand without this motion [27:10-11]

motions.name: Division of the Assembly
motions.window: from casting of negative votes until immediately after result announced [29:4(1), 45:9]
motions.notes: compels an uncounted rising retake only; counting needs chair's order or majority [29:5, 4:53]; yields to nothing under the incidental yield rule [6:19]

motions.name: Motions Relating to Methods of Voting and the Polls
motions.interrupt_notes: preference in recognition to move re a vote just taken [30:3(3)]
motions.notes: incidental only while the question is pending or vote just announced; else incidental main [30:2]; never retake by the same method [30:6]

motions.name: Request to Be Excused from a Duty

second.rule: only when moved formally by the requester [32:2(4)]

motions.reconsider: neg-only once the person has learned of the action [32:2(8)]

motions.name: Requests and Inquiries (family)
motions.shared: interrupt when immediate response needed; not debatable; not amendable; grant-motions by another member need no second [33:2]

motions.name: Create a Blank (by striking out)
motions.notes: movable while a related amendment is pending; its adoption disposes of that amendment and pools the specifications as proposals [12:95]

motions.name: Proposal for Filling a Blank
motions.vote_notes: proposals voted seriatim until one attains majority; ordering rules: money-to-spend high->low [12:109], money-to-accept low->high [12:110], names in proposal order [12:107], places/dates/numbers per 12:111
motions.limit: one proposal per member per open slot [12:97]

motions.name: Take from the Table
motions.interrupt_notes: preference in recognition over a new main motion, incl. one made but not yet stated [34:2(3), 34:4]
motions.window: same session, or through next regular session if within quarterly interval [34:3]; cannot interrupt a connected series [34:5]
motions.precondition: not in order until some business or interrupting matter has been dealt with since the tabling (renewal after rejection likewise waits for further business) [34:2(2)]

motions.name: Rescind / Amend Something Previously Adopted
motions.vote_notes: alternatives — any one suffices [35:2(7)]; the notice alternative requires notice stating the complete substance of the change, given at the previous meeting within a quarterly interval or in the call [35:2(7)]; in a committee: two-thirds, dropping to majority only when every member who voted for the target motion is present or received reasonable notice [35:2(7)]; bylaws/special rules follow their own amendment requirements
motions.not_applicable: when reachable via a pending reconsider; executed acts impossible to undo; accepted resignations / elections-expulsions once notified [35:6]
motions.scope_rule: amendments beyond the scope of given notice destroy the notice's effect (or are out of order where notice is required) [35:2(6), 35:4]

motions.name: Discharge a Committee
motions.class_rule: B when the matter was referred while pending (subsidiary commit); M/B when referred by main motion [36:10-11]
motions.vote_exceptions: majority alone when committee missed a prescribed reporting time, or while a partial report is being considered [36:4(7)]

motions.name: Reconsider
motions.making_vs_consideration: MAKING takes precedence over everything and yields to nothing [37:9(1a)]; CONSIDERATION has only the rank of the motion to be reconsidered [37:9(1b)] — precedence.json reconsider_split_rank

interrupt.when: making: after floor assigned, before the speaker begins; calling up: no

motions.second_notes: any member may second; call-up needs none [37:9(4)]
motions.mover: prevailing side only (assembly); committee: anyone not on the losing side [37:10(a), 37:35]
motions.window: same day, or next business day within the session [37:10(b)]; committees: no limit [37:35]. A made reconsider is withdrawable only within these same limits — after it is too late to renew, withdrawal needs unanimous consent [37:10(b)]
motions.vote_notes: majority regardless of the target's threshold [37:9(7)]; in a standing/special committee: two-thirds, dropping to majority only when every member who voted with the prevailing side is present or received reasonable notice [37:35(3)]
motions.not_applicable: renewable motions; certain negative votes now conflicting; partly executed affirmatives; notified contracts; undoable acts; votes on reconsider itself; finalized elections; results reachable by another majority-without-notice motion [37:9(2)]

motions.name: Reconsider and Enter on the Minutes
motions.delta_from_reconsider: made same day as the vote only; outranks plain reconsider even mid-announcement; not where a day's delay defeats the object; not at last business meeting before a >quarterly gap; not callable-up same day (last-day-of-session exception) [37:47]
motions.applies_to: exactly: (a) aff or neg vote on a main motion; (b) aff vote on postpone-indefinitely; (c) neg vote on objection-to-consideration when the session extends beyond the day [37:47(3)] — narrower than 'votes finally disposing of a main motion': e.g. an affirmative vote on commit disposes of nothing finally and is excluded, and the objection case reaches only the vote's negative form (the sustaining vote IS the negative [26:7])

rule_clusters.name: (rule cluster) Renewal of motions
rule_clusters.notes: not a motion; the same-session non-renewal principle and its exceptions [38:1-9] live as guards: renewable-after-progress (commit, postpone, limit-extend, previous-question, lay-on-table [38:7(1)]), after-business (take-from-table [38:7(2)], orders-call [38:7(3)]), after-progress (adjourn, recess [38:7(4)]), nominations/polls [38:7(5)]; later-session renewal blocked while question remains within assembly's control [38:8]

aliases.desc: Names that resolve to registry records without their own rows.

incidental_main_variants.desc: Same name, moved when nothing is pending; class M, debatable and amendable per main-motion rules unless noted. Selected by guard/no-question-pending.
incidental_main_variants.NOTE(judgment): these are modeled as contextual variants selected by the guard no-question-pending, not as separate registry rows, except where thresholds or reconsiderability differ (noted per entry — variants do NOT inherit main-motion attributes wholesale; Table II is the per-row authority the re-expansion sweep checks against).

entries.variant: voting/nomination method motions when no election pending

NOTE(judgment): Registry granularity — Table II's ~98 rows collapse here to ~30 rule-bearing records plus contextual variants; rows that are pure cross-references (substitute -> amend; refer -> commit) are aliases, and incidental-main duplicates are guard-selected variants. Re-expansion to Table-II row granularity is mechanical from these records — treated as a testable claim by acceptance.json sweep table-ii-reexpansion.
